title: J. Antigravity adapter
description:
Purpose: add Google Antigravity (VS Code-based AI IDE) session transcripts as a required later source, via its own adapter conforming to the shared normalized record. Ryan's Mac (BlackbookM1) has Antigravity installed; all research happens there with counts and schema/field names only, never message text.

Scope: (1) research and pin the real on-disk format on this Mac — look under ~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity, ~/.gemini/antigravity, ~/.antigravity, and any state.vscdb if VS Code-based — recording schema/field names and counts only; (2) discovery; (3) human-message extraction with injected-content exclusions; (4) dedup/rescan/doctor consistent with the other sources; (5) synthetic fixtures and tests, then wire into the CLI sources and doctor.

Done when: the research is recorded (with citations or clearly marked assumptions); golden extraction tests pass on synthetic fixtures; Antigravity sessions appear in the meter counts alongside the other sources; privacy rules apply identically.
